title: Board Lods Grid Snap And Svg Icons
description: Board: four discrete LODs (minimap/overview/normal/detail) with configurable zoom thresholds as props; per-LOD grid (none / 10 / 10+5 / 10+5+1), node stroke/fill, edge weight, handles, labels vs abbreviated vs vello_svg icons; grid snap to visible grid lines with toolbar toggle; integrate vello_svg for detail node icons from metabolism example SVGs.
